meta.title: 阅读理解 A 篇 · Wild Nature Camp（示例截短版）
meta.subtitle: 阅读理解（21–23，3 题）
meta.source: 示例：真实样例的截短版，只用来看字段形状

passage.genre: 应用文（活动公告 / 招募通知）
passage.topic: 野外自然营招募：目的、活动、规则、费用与报名

blocks.text: For teenagers longing to escape from busy school life and reconnect with nature, the Wild Nature Camp is established to build self-independence and environmental awareness.
This summer camp will run from July 18 to July 29, targeting students aged 15 to 17 with basic outdoor living skills.
Unlike common summer camps, this camp features wilderness hiking, plant research, eco-camping skills and group challenges, all led by professional instructors.
Every activity is carefully planned to help participants (参与者) step out of their comfort zones and develop problem-solving skills.
Expensive electronic devices (设备), such as smart watches, are not encouraged, as they may prevent participants from enjoying outdoor experiences.
Only basic mobile phones are permitted for daily contact with parents.
Second, anyone who fails to follow instructors' orders will be stopped from certain activities.
Camp fees include meals, accommodation, training equipment, insurance and activity materials.
However, participants are required to prepare their own daily necessities.
Besides, each participant must hand in a health statement report to prove they are physically fit for long-distance walking and outdoor camping.
The camp program only accepts 120 participants on a first-come, first-served basis, so early sign-up is highly advised.
Once registration is completed, no fee will be returned for personal reasons.

translation: 对于渴望逃离繁忙学校生活、重新亲近自然的青少年来说，野外自然营的设立目的就是培养自立能力与环保意识。这个夏令营将于 7 月 18 日至 7 月 29 日举办，面向 15 至 17 岁、具备基本野外生活技能的学生。
与普通夏令营不同，本营以荒野徒步、植物研究、生态露营技能和团队挑战为特色，全部由专业教练带领。每一项活动都经过精心策划，以帮助参与者走出自己的舒适区、培养解决问题的能力。
昂贵的电子设备（如智能手表）不受鼓励，因为它们可能使参与者无法尽情享受户外体验。只允许携带普通手机，用于与父母的日常联系。其次，任何不服从教练指令的人将被停止参加某些活动。
营费包括餐饮、住宿、训练装备、保险和活动材料。但是，参与者需要自备日常生活用品。此外，每位参与者必须上交一份健康声明报告，以证明其身体状况适合长距离徒步与户外露营。
报名将于 7 月 5 日截止。营地项目仅招收 120 名参与者，按先到先得的原则，因此强烈建议尽早报名。一旦报名完成，因个人原因将不予退费。

hardSentences.en: Unlike common summer camps, this camp features wilderness hiking, plant research, eco-camping skills and group challenges, all led by professional instructors.
hardSentences.zh: 与普通夏令营不同，本营以荒野徒步、植物研究、生态露营技能和团队挑战为特色，全部由专业教练带领。
hardSentences.note: 主干为 this camp features A, B, C and D，feature 作动词「以……为特色」，后接四个由 and 连接的并列宾语；句首 Unlike common summer camps 是介词短语作比较状语；句末 all led by professional instructors 是独立主格结构（all 指代 all activities），过去分词 led 表被动，补充说明所有活动均由专业教练带领。

structure: 体裁：应用文（活动公告 / 招募通知），语篇模式为总—分式：第 1 段总述 + 4 个小标题分述，共 5 段
第 1 段 · 总述·简介：办营目的（自立 + 环保意识）、营期（7 月 18–29 日）、对象（15–17 岁、有基本野外生活技能）
culture: Summer camp（夏令营）：北美延续百余年的传统，中产家庭暑假把孩子送进营地住一到两周，远离城市与电子屏幕，在集体生活中学习独立
营地通常按年龄分组，本文 targeting students aged 15 to 17 就是典型的「青少年组」

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the Wild Nature Camp?
questions.stemCn: 野外自然营的主要目的是什么？

options.text: To offer teenagers a chance to make friends.
options.cn: 给青少年提供交朋友的机会
options.why: make friends（交朋友）在原文中无中生有：营地是为渴望逃离繁忙学业、重新亲近自然的青少年而设，并未把交友作为办营目的。

options.text: To provide part-time jobs for teenagers in summer.
options.cn: 为青少年提供暑期兼职工作
options.why: part-time jobs（兼职工作）并非营地目的；participants 是来参加活动的青少年，不是来打工的。

options.text: To train teenagers to become future nature instructors.
options.cn: 把青少年培养成未来的自然教练
options.why: 原文的 instructors 是「由专业教练带领活动」的服务方，选项把服务方偷换成「把青少年培养成教练」这一培养目标。

options.text: To develop teenagers' self-support and green-awareness.
options.cn: 培养青少年的自立能力与环保意识

evidence.text: For teenagers longing to escape from busy school life and reconnect with nature, the Wild Nature Camp is established to build self-independence and environmental awareness.

questions.analysis: 定位第 1 段「the Wild Nature Camp is established to build self-independence and environmental awareness」——self-independence 即 self-support（自立），environmental awareness 即 green-awareness（环保意识），D 项是原文的同义转述。A、B 两项原文均未提及，C 项则把「由教练带队」说成「培养教练」。

points.tag: 细节题 · 目的句定位

questions.tip: 看到 established to / aims to / in order to，先圈出 to 后面的动词短语，那往往就是主旨目的题的原句。

hints.text: 考点方向：细节题问「办营的主要目的」，要回到第 1 段找表目的的不定式（is established to do sth.）。
原文定位（第 1 段）：For teenagers longing to escape from busy school life and reconnect with nature, the Wild Nature Camp is established to build self-independence and environmental awareness.
A 项 make friends 属无中生有；B 项 part-time jobs 张冠李戴，参与者是来活动的不是来打工的；C 项把「由专业教练带领」偷换成「把青少年培养成教练」。
答案 D。build self-independence and environmental awareness 中，self-independence = self-support（自立），environmental awareness = green-awareness（环保意识），D 项为原文同义转述。
